funding: Created in 2020 by Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Culture; the culture minister chairs its board.

name: Djerassi Resident Artists Program
watch: Alexander Maxwell Djerassi has been a Djerassi trustee since 2017 and is now board secretary. An itinerary in the DOJ files lists him and fellow trustee Michael Molesky as guests at a "Mindshift Conference" on the weekend of 7 January 2011, with events on St. Thomas and on Epstein's island, Little St. James.
records_note: Djerassi posts audit reports and Form 990s for fiscal 2014 to 2022 and names its trustees, but no annual report or donor list.

name: Eiteljorg Museum of American Indians and Western Art
watch: Citizens Energy Group, Indianapolis's natural-gas utility, is a current fossil-fuel funder. It is on the live Corporate Giving partner list. The 2023 annual report also lists it as a $5k-$19,999 donor and a Día de Muertos 2023 sponsor. It is a gas distributor, not a producer. Other names: Lilly Endowment and Eli Lilly (pharma), banks not under campaign, Hiatus Tequila and Sun King Brewery (alcohol).

name: English National Ballet
watch: Prince Andrew was patron of English National Ballet for 18 years. ENB accepted his resignation "with immediate effect" on 22 November 2019, after his Newsnight interview about Epstein, and some ENB trustees had joined calls for him to go.
why_flagged: Arts Council England supports it as a National Portfolio Organisation. Ballymore is principal building partner and Cunard sponsors productions. Trusts include Garfield Weston and Bloomberg Philanthropies.
records_note: Filed accounts for 2024 and 2025 sit at Companies House; its site names donors by level and 11 trustees but posts no annual report.

name: Eskenazi Museum of Art
funding: The art museum of Indiana University, a public university. Sidney and Lois Eskenazi gave $15M in 2016 for the renovation and the name.
watch: Indiana University cancelled the Samia Halaby retrospective in December 2023. PEN America urged reinstatement and a petition drew 8,000 signatures.
